The Table of Nations (Gen 10:21-31) traces the Semitic peoples -- Elam, Asshur, Aram, and Eber -- back to him, and the genealogy of Genesis 11:10-26 connects Shem directly to Abram. German translations interestingly render the name as 'Schem,' preserving a closer phonetic echo of the Hebrew."

Also in 1 Chronicles 1:4, 17, 24 in the same genealogical role.
